description: Digital nomad visa programs ranked by cost, income requirements, duration, and tax treatment. 24 countries with active or widely-used remote work visa programs.
methodology: Data sourced from official government immigration portals and embassy publications. Income requirements standardized to USD/year. Costs in USD at current exchange rates. Tax treatment reflects the regime available to DN visa holders specifically.
attribution: WhereNext (getwherenext.com). Data sourced from official government immigration portals.
